# Living AI Orb

Living AI Orb is a dependency-free JavaScript and HTML Canvas visual interface for AI voice assistants, voice agents, virtual assistants, conversational AI products and realtime voice experiences.

Canonical project: https://github.com/dinuduke/living-ai-orb
Live demo: https://dinuduke.github.io/living-ai-orb/

## Core capabilities

- Interactive particle-based AI orb
- AI assistant speaking state with glowing, articulating edges
- Browser text-to-speech with the Web Speech API
- Microphone-reactive animation with the Web Audio API
- Circle-to-oval horizontal morphing
- Left-to-right color travel
- Pointer, touch and click particle interaction
- Public JavaScript API for integration with external voice agents and TTS systems
- No JavaScript framework or runtime dependency

## Relevant concepts

AI orb, voice orb, voice assistant orb, AI voice assistant UI, voice AI UI, voice agent UI, virtual assistant UI, conversational AI UI, realtime voice interface, audio-reactive visualization, interactive AI avatar, living AI interface, particle animation, Canvas animation, Web Audio API, Web Speech API.

## Integration

See INTEGRATION.md in the repository for iframe, vanilla JavaScript, custom TTS, voice agent, React and Next.js integration patterns.
